class="primary-container"> <div class="page-width-container" id="page-width-container">    <div class="main-content">                   <article class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Generate Video Overviews in Gemini Notebook</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p><strong>Important:</strong>&nbsp;At this time, the Gemini Notebook mobile app may have limitations to this feature.&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16296687" rel="noopener">Learn more about the supported features in Gemini Notebook mobile app</a>.</p>

<p>Video Overviews transform the sources in your notebook into an engaging video. They distill complex information into clear, digestible content, providing a comprehensive and engaging visual deep dive of your material.&nbsp;</p>

<h2>Generate a Video Overview</h2>

<ol>
  <li>Open an existing notebook or create a new one and upload sources.
    <ul>
      <li>To generate or delete a Video Overview, you need edit access to a notebook.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>In the "Studio" panel, select "Video Overview" to initiate generation of a new video.&nbsp;Before generating, you can customize your video if you would like; otherwise, Gemini Notebook will create a video overview using default settings.</li>
  <li>After you provide the format, language, visual styles, and other custom instructions as needed, select “generate” to start creating your video overview. The video will be generated in the background, so you can generate other artifacts concurrently or even navigate to other screens.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Important</strong>:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Video Overviews, including voices and visuals, are AI-generated and may contain inaccuracies or audio glitches.</li>
  <li>Gemini Notebook may take a while to generate the Video Overview (sometimes, more than 30 minutes). Feel free to come back to your notebook later.</li>
</ul>

<h2>(Optional) Customize your Video Overview:</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> Cinematic and Short Video Overviews only support English. They’re available to users ages 18+.</p>

<p>To customize your Video Overviews, specify the following:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Format</strong>: Choose the type of video that works best for you.

    <ul>
      <li><strong>Cinematic:</strong> A rich, immersive experience that can unpack the complex ideas of your sources through engaging visuals and storytelling.</li>
      <li><strong>Explainer:</strong> A structured, comprehensive overview that connects the dots within your sources.&nbsp;</li>
      <li><strong>Short:</strong> Quickly grasp key concepts from your sources in ~60 second videos.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Language:</strong> Pick from any of our supported languages for your video's narration.</li>
  <li><strong>Visual Style:</strong> Select a look for your video (only for 18+ users, excluding Cinematic and Short Video Overviews). You can choose styles in these ways:
    <ul>
      <li>Choose from styles like <strong>Classic, Whiteboard, Watercolor, Retro Print, Heritage, Paper-craft,</strong> <strong>Kawaii, </strong>and <strong>Anime</strong>.</li>
      <li>Let Gemini Notebook<strong> auto-select</strong> a style for you.</li>
      <li>To generate a custom visual style, choose <strong>Custom</strong> and input a description.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>(Optional) Steering prompt:</strong> Select a suggested topic for the overview to focus on, or provide a custom topic.</li>
</ul>

<h2>Manage your Video Overview:</h2>

<ul>
  <li>To change the playback speed, select a different speed from “1x”.</li>
  <li>Navigate forward or backwards in the video by using the playback slider, or by tapping “rewind” or “skip forward”.</li>
  <li>Enter full screen mode by clicking on the full screen button</li>
  <li>To send feedback, tap “good video” or “bad video”</li>
</ul>

<h2>Play a Video Overview</h2>

<p><strong>Important</strong>: This is only applicable to notebooks that have previously generated Video Overviews.</p>

<ol>
  <li>Open an existing notebook.</li>
  <li>In the "Studio" panel, select the title of your previously generated Video Overview.</li>
  <li>Once the video player opens, start the Video Overview by hitting “play”&nbsp;</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Tip</strong>: to view the prompt used to generate your audio overview, select <strong>“View custom prompt”</strong> within the three dots menu next to your artifact in the Studio panel.</p>

<h2>Share a Video Overview</h2>

<h3>Option 1: Share a link</h3>

<ol>
  <li>Generate a Video Overview.</li>
  <li>In the video player, select Share.</li>
  <li>Confirm that the notebook is shared with the recipient or is made public (open to “Anyone with a link”), and viewers have access to the “full notebook.”</li>
  <li>Copy link to Video Overview to share with recipient.</li>
  <li>Save to apply changes.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Important</strong>:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Public notebook sharing is only enabled for consumer accounts. It's currently disabled for Workspace Enterprise or Education accounts.</li>
  <li>Only notebook owners and editors can make a&nbsp; generated video publicly available and manage its access. As an owner or editor, you can turn off public access by selecting a different Notebook access level in the sharing panel.</li>
  <li>Once a video is deleted, any previously generated share link will no longer work.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Option 2: Share the entire notebook</h3>

<ol>
  <li>Generate a Video Overview.</li>
  <li>Share the full notebook.
    <ul>
      <li>Other users can access the Video Overview in the "Studio" panel.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>

<h3>Option 3: Download &amp; share the Video Overview</h3>

<ol>
  <li>To download the Video Overview, select Download <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/u302ab4TiFR05BhsSU6w9_BMei25wSRGjSdCPxhvzGzR9XAMmpKgUWfpFtx_NkZWmQWw=w36-h36" width="18" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/u302ab4TiFR05BhsSU6w9_BMei25wSRGjSdCPxhvzGzR9XAMmpKgUWfpFtx_NkZWmQWw">.</li>
  <li>Share the downloaded video file.</li>
</ol>

<p><strong>Tip: </strong>Depending on the publisher's content restrictions, you may not be able to download artifacts generated using a notebook that has a Play Books ebook as a source.</p>

<h2>Set your output language for Video Overviews</h2>

<p><a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16261963" rel="noopener">Learn how to change your output language in Gemini Notebook.</a></p>
